issues.title: Ingest the Middlesex Sheriffs Office appropriation
issues.detail: Pull the Sheriff line item (8910) from the Massachusetts state budget.
issues.learned: FY2026 enacted $79,416,165 (operations line 8910-0107 = $77,418,880), the 4th-largest of Massachusetts 14 sheriff offices. It is state money, not a county tax — the one real county-level budget Middlesex still has. Prior year FY2025 was $79,423,908, fully line-itemized.

issues.title: Ingest the flagship city budgets
issues.detail: The real money is municipal. Ingesting Cambridge and Lowell first so residents can walk a budget that actually governs them; a full index of all 54 cities and towns follows.
